risk_note: RV2 review standard by precedent for App.tsx registration (apps/admin/src/pages/messages/**, texts/messages.ts, resources/index.ts, App.tsx). The admin 「消息模板」 page follows the merged CT-24t (#1558: adminListNotifyChannels, adminSwitchNotifyChannels, adminRegisterNotifySms, adminDiscardNotifySms, adminRetestNotifySms, adminEnableNotifySms) and the final design design/specs/admin-notify-templates.md (D10-337 / D10-339). Channel switches need a totp step-up each time, and turning SMS billing from off to on asks for a second confirmation first. The SMS switch is greyed when sms_ready is false and shows 「开（未就绪）」 when it is on but not ready. The SMS tab shows active / pending status, saves as pending, and offers test-send / retest, discard (Popconfirm) and enable (fund codes also need content.fund_terms). On 50301 / 50401 the page shows the save as not accepted and refreshes the list; 20001 errors are placed by data.fields / reason. Read permission is content.article or notify.channels; write controls are hidden without notify.channels. The menu gains notify.channels; the frozen admin-shell/fixtures.ts adds only that row. No backend, money, ledger, migration or contract change. Handover: fe (10-24, against the CT-24t draft) → be → ops (orchestrator 03:39). Rule tests were rewritten in round 3 by a fresh independent Claude per D10-409 against the merged contract and design; red PASS on the spec commit (72 red, 0 problems). Implementation by an Opus 5.5 subagent, with the fe draft implementation as reference. verify:fast exit 0 and --browser exit 0 in the test-machine container. Left for the orchestrator: the design's test-send for an active configuration has no contract operation; DATA_COPY_CODE's template type is treated as notice. Full verify on the test machine (verify/1): exit 124 at the 3600 s limit with no failing case before it; admin-messages (access, channels, switch, sms-list, sms-edit, sms-actions, states) and admin-shell menu / shell tests passed; recorded per D10-319, CI verify-int is the check.
